content.title: Chapter 2 - ADMINISTRATION — Sec. 2-121. - Administrative policies and procedures.
content.summary:
The city manager is authorized to promulgate and enforce administrative policies and
               procedures consistent with law relating to the exercise by the city manager of supervision
               and control over the executive and administrative departments of the city and employees
      …

faqs.a:
The city manager is authorized to promulgate and enforce administrative policies and
               procedures consistent with law relating to the exercise by the city manager of supervision
               and control over the executive and administrative departments of the city and employees
               thereof.
(Code 1981, § 2-101; Ord. No. 2473, § 1, 12-21-1987)
